request.prompt: A single old Lebanon cedar tree, Cedrus libani, stylized low-poly game asset. One massive thick straight trunk with rough bark. Foliage in several wide flat horizontal tiers, stacked layers of dense dark blue-green needles spreading sideways like broad plates, clear gaps of bare trunk and thick horizontal branches between the layers. Irregular asymmetric crown ending in a wide flat table-shaped top, much wider than tall at the top. Not a cone, not a pine, not a Christmas tree. Isolated on a plain background, no ground, no rocks, no shadows, flat matte colors.
